ALERTS.EMPTY_HINT: Results of background jobs, imports and exports, and system messages show up here.

PLATFORM.TITLE: Managed Composable Commerce for complex B2B
PLATFORM.BODY: An open-source, API-first platform on .NET, run for you on Virto Cloud. Start with what you need and add modules as the business grows.
PLATFORM.POINT_1: Virto Cloud hosts, scales, updates and monitors your environments
PLATFORM.POINT_2: 100+ modules you install, update or replace one at a time
PLATFORM.POINT_3: Connect any storefront, ERP or marketplace through open APIs

CATALOG.TITLE: One catalog for every channel and price list
CATALOG.BODY: Manage physical, digital and configurable products once, then publish them to each store with its own assortment and prices.
CATALOG.POINT_1: Virtual catalogs that reuse products across stores and channels
CATALOG.POINT_2: Price lists with quantity tiers, dates and customer-segment rules
CATALOG.POINT_3: Inventory across warehouses and fulfillment centers

B2B.TITLE: Built for the way businesses buy
B2B.BODY: Company accounts, buyers and contracts, with the quotes and recurring orders that B2B deals depend on.
B2B.POINT_1: Organizations with their buyers, roles and addresses
B2B.POINT_2: Quotes and contract pricing negotiated per customer
B2B.POINT_3: Subscriptions that reorder on a schedule

API.TITLE: Open, API-first and agent-ready
API.BODY: Every capability is an API: build any front end, let AI agents shop and act on your behalf, and extend the platform with your own modules.
API.POINT_1: GraphQL xAPI for storefronts, apps and integrations
API.POINT_2: Agentic Access via MCP for AI assistants and agents
API.POINT_3: Native Support for UCP and OnX Protocols
